heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for premium image creation, synchronized video generation, and multimodal creative control.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use an unexpected cinematic-console hybrid hero: full-bleed abstract AI shell background with layered product output mockups and a narrow right-side floating proof rail, instead of a standard split image panel. Keep the interface dark and developer-minimal with copper accent CTAs, hard-shadow cards, precision grid lines, and subtle orb/mesh treatments. Treat the media as layered evidence: one large abstract hero visual, one smaller video preview card, and one technical output strip to signal professional control rather than playful creativity.

repetitionBreakers: Hero is split and media-led, then trust becomes a static logo grid, followed by an interactive tabs-with-preview product block, then an alternating spotlight-plus-grid feature sequence, then a comparison-style pricing/cart section, and ending with a centered lead form.
Background alternates section by section between #06080c and #0f1117 to prevent visual monotony.
Feature treatment changes across product blocks: Seedream uses a preview-led split panel, Seedance uses a video-first accordion-with-visual, and testimonials use a compact 3-card grid.
CTA treatment remains consistent in label but changes placement priority from hero-first to product emphasis to final conversion block.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro | AI Image & Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Create high-quality AI images and videos with ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Explore multimodal generation, synchronized audio-video creation, and enterprise-ready creative control.

sections.backgroundTreatment: precision-line grid with subtle model-glow overlays and dark premium depth
sections.designNote: Hero must answer what this is, who it is for, and what to do next. Keep the headline direct and high-clarity: AI image and video generation for creative professionals. Left side is content-first for continuity with the ad message; right side shows a refined output mockup / abstract model shell. Use one strong CTA only: Get started. Make the CTA accent-filled at 100% opacity and full-width on mobile. Keep the message premium, technical, and immediately credible.

Place trust immediately after the hero because traffic is warm and proof should arrive early. Use 3-6 recognizable customer/partner logos in a clean static flex-wrap grid. If real logos are unavailable, replace with a metrics strip rather than filler badges. Keep this band compact and highly legible, with minimal ornament so the logos carry the credibility weight.

Because there are 5+ features in each product section, do not use a static card grid. Use tabs with a live preview panel for Seedream 4.5 first, then alternate into a visual-first split panel for Seedance 1.5 Pro. Seedream should spotlight image quality, typographic rendering, and multimodal editing. Seedance should focus on synchronized audio-video generation, cinematic control, multilingual lip-sync, and speed. Keep the rhythm product-led and technical rather than marketing-heavy, with distinct visual treatments between the two product blocks.

Use this as a brief credibility bridge rather than a generic benefits section. Since the brand’s own why-section is sparse, convert it into a compact 2-3 card utility grid that reinforces procurement confidence: fast evaluation, expert guidance, and demo-led decision support. Keep it visually quieter than the product sections so it does not compete with the model story.

Use a conversion-oriented comparison layout with two emphasized cards: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Because the page is lead-gen and not self-serve checkout, frame pricing as inquiry-led rather than transactional. Highlight the Seedance starting price where relevant, but preserve one consistent CTA label: Get started. Keep the cards hard-shadowed, premium, and structured, with one dominant card treatment and one secondary card to create visual hierarchy.

With 4+ testimonials available, use a concise 3-card grid or compact carousel-static pattern. Lead with role-specific quotes from Creative Director, Video Producer, and Art Director to make proof industry-specific. Keep this section visually calmer after pricing, using shorter cards and stronger quote emphasis. The testimonials should validate speed, quality, and multimodal control rather than repeat feature claims.

End with a centered conversion card that feels decisive, not noisy. Reinforce the value of seeing the models in action over a generic sign-up. Keep the form minimal since no detailed fields were provided; treat it as a request/demo capture. Primary CTA remains Get started, accent-filled and full-width on mobile. This should be the cleanest, highest-contrast section after the proof stack.

If additional media logos or press marks exist, use a static horizontal logo strip only; do not use a marquee. If no credible logos exist, skip this section entirely. Keep this utility-only and non-promotional so it does not dilute the final CTA energy.

blueprint.designPersonality: High-precision, enterprise-ready AI studio for creators who want speed without losing control. The page should feel like a professional model platform: dark, structured, credible, and outcome-driven, with logos doing most of the trust work and the video gallery acting as the visual centerpiece.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use premium abstract AI visual shells, model output mockups, and a dedicated video gallery section with cinematic thumbnails. Keep visuals technical and refined rather than playful. Proof and trust should be reinforced with a prominent logo band, subtle capability chips, and enterprise-style product cards.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and benefits from a compact, authoritative size to preserve hierarchy and avoid wrapping overload in a dark hero.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width split hero with brand/logo anchoring, large bold headline, concise supporting paragraph, and a short feature-benefit list using icon bullets. Primary conversion is emphasized immediately in the hero, with content stacked vertically on mobile and laid out as a strong introductory band.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single dominant hero followed by a form/lead-capture block, using clear vertical separation and straightforward section stacking rather than dense multi-column storytelling. The page favors a linear conversion flow over exploratory navigation.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple rectangular content cards with minimal ornamentation, likely medium-radius, light surface, and strong heading hierarchy. Cards appear utility-focused rather than decorative, with compact feature lists and little visual complexity.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One primary CTA in the hero and a secondary request/demo action in the product area. CTA hierarchy is direct and conversion-oriented, using short imperative labels and repeating the same action model across sections.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module pattern is visible; the page appears lead-gen focused rather than self-serve purchase oriented.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer pattern is not represented in the provided structure; assume minimal or utility-only footer if present.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Text-led landing page with limited visual media emphasis in the provided excerpt. When media appears, it is likely logo/icon based rather than large illustrative panels, with visuals serving trust and recognition rather than storytelling.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Feature sections are structured as labeled product modules with a product name, short headline, descriptive paragraph, CTA, and then a list of capabilities. The pattern supports progressive disclosure: summary first, detailed benefits second. Best suited to long-form B2B pages with multiple products or model variants.
referenceMap.formPattern: Lead-capture form embedded immediately after the hero in a dedicated form card. Uses multiple hidden tracking fields and a prominent form heading, indicating a high-intent conversion path with analytics integration and minimal friction.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-first presentation with no explicit animated interaction patterns in the provided structure.
designNotes: Prioritize clarity and immediacy over visual complexity.
Use a strong typographic hierarchy with headline, subheadline, and feature bullets.
Keep the conversion path short by placing the form high on the page.
Use consistent icon bullets and compact list spacing for scanability.
Structure long content as modular product blocks with repeated CTA behavior.
Favor enterprise/B2B credibility cues over decorative marketing effects.

blueprint.heroFormBgRule: MANDATORY: Use heroBackgroundVideo as full-bleed autoplay muted loop video behind everything

mustHaveMoments: Full-width dark hero with bold product message and immediate primary CTA
Prominent logo-led trust strip placed near the hero for maximum credibility
Readable feature storytelling for Seedream 4.5 without grid-on-grid complexity
Dedicated Seedance 1.5 Pro video gallery section to demonstrate motion, audio, and cinematic quality
Clear product separation between image generation and video generation capabilities
Lead-capture or demo-request conversion block after the core product proof
Testimonial section with role-based quotes from creative and marketing professionals
Pricing/quote area with request-action emphasis for enterprise-style evaluation
Sticky top strip or persistent top navigation to keep the CTA accessible while scrolling
Minimal utility footer to close the page cleanly without distracting from conversion
avoidPatterns: Do not use an additional lead magnet
Do not use a grid inside a grid for feature presentation
Do not hide the full page behind a hero-only experience
Do not overload the page with decorative complexity or scattered content
Do not mismatch content between image and video product sections
Do not omit the form/lead capture if the page strategy requires it
Do not use a self-serve ecommerce framing
Do not bury logo trust below testimonials or generic badges
designStrategy.reasoning: This page is a high-intent lead-generation landing page for professional users evaluating advanced AI image and video models, so the strategy should prioritize conversion clarity and enterprise credibility over exploration. Because the audience trusts logos most, the trust system should be logo-led and placed early. The content is inherently product-led: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro need clear separation, strong visual proof, and concise capability explanation. A split hero suits the dual-product story while keeping the CTA prominent. Dark premium styling reinforces the advanced AI positioning and works well with a video gallery section. The page should feel linear, readable, and demo-oriented, with strong CTAs, proof blocks, testimonials, and a clean footer.
